scope: Original SVG construction and palette in this directory, not the reference screenshots or HP software.
method: New hand-specified geometry written for the repository. Circles, polygon edges and lines were scan-converted into explicit integer SVG rectangles because Qt SVG ignores crispEdges on those primitives. No screenshots, traced reference pixels, embedded raster tiles, HP logo or proprietary theme assets are distributed.

changes: The institutional emblem uses literal neutral matte grays instead of blue-gray.
The terminal gains the HP-like multiband monitor frame and perspective keyboard details.
The second lower-strip symbol is an asymmetric palette/tool silhouette with cutouts instead of a gear.
The third lower-strip symbol is a low rectangular tool with irregular stepped top, without a filing-action interpretation.
asset_revisions.method: New coordinate-based drawings; no source-reference bitmap pixels are sampled into or embedded in SVG assets.

changes: Two-color instrument checkerboard, 2x2 pixels.
Two-color command-rail hatching, 2x3 pixels.
Raised borders begin with a bright highlight; pixel-grid drawing retains highlights at 50%.
asset_revisions.method: New integer-coordinate vector patterns and fixed colors; reference screenshots are not embedded or distributed.

changes: The user replaces the earlier neutral-gray institutional treatment with predominant blue colors consistent with the DomainOS schema.
The label now uses two lines GNU/ and LINUX, broad integer-coordinate block glyphs and a one-pixel dark incised offset, following the HP two-line identification treatment.
A low-contrast dark-blue backing keeps the engraving readable inside the patterned institutional rail rather than using a separately raised smooth plate.
asset_revisions.method: Original integer-coordinate geometry and literal colors already used by the panel palette; no reference image pixels, font file or HP logo embedded.

changes: Dark-on-pale identification plate with a simple raised metal frame.
Checker background with exactly four central grooves rendered by QML.
17x12 recessed indicator with a 13x7 blue lens, pale rim and inner dark shadow.
Five lower-rail symbols reconstructed in two colors on 32x24 canvases.
asset_revisions.method: New integer-coordinate SVG geometry and QML; reference screenshot bitmaps are not embedded or distributed.

changes: The indicator gains a 19x14 outer mounting recess with two-pixel top/left shadow, preserving the 17x12 rim and the position of the 13x7 blue lens.
GNU/LINUX uses proportional eight-pixel capitals with uniform solid two-pixel stems and an upper/left exterior highlight that does not cover the glyph body.
asset_revisions.method: New integer-coordinate SVG shapes; no font files, HP logo or reference screenshot bitmaps embedded.

changes: The QML metal rail is reduced from 30 to the reference 26 displayed pixels, retaining four centered grooves and four-pixel checker margins.
The chassis gains the reference two-pixel cyan lip and two-pixel cyan shadow; the total 1942x218 canvas and the seal/lens/symbol sizes are preserved.
asset_revisions.method: Integer QML geometry and solid cyan colors; reference image bitmaps are not distributed.

changes: The 20-pixel seal drawing has three pixels of vertical clearance on a 26-pixel plate; its lettering keeps eight-pixel capitals and a single free interline row.
The four instrument frames have uniform two-pixel highlights/shadows at half scale, preserving four pixels of visual separation between faces without an empty gap.
The chassis gains a continuous right cyan/shadow border, with space reserved outside the module relief; the metal height and cyan footer are preserved.
asset_revisions.method: Integer-coordinate SVG and QML geometry; screenshot pixels and proprietary assets are not embedded or distributed.

changes: The four equal instruments now occupy 166x150 canonical units, reaching the iconbox and metal rail with a single right/bottom button frame.
The redundant enclosing bevel is removed; the four-pixel visual separation between neighboring faces is preserved.
asset_revisions.method: Integer-coordinate QML layout; reference image pixels are not distributed.

changes: The graph and Mail faces are reconstructed on 60x35 and 56x27 native canvases, preserving their measured reference proportions rather than stretching the old taller drawings.
Date, graph and Mail use a uniform enlargement based on the current cell width; the clock face and tapered hands share the exact cell center.
The iconbox, pager, tray and navigation modules expose their own two-pixel upper relief below the cyan chassis, and their contents are recentered.
Pager sample footers are positioned within the map, avoiding overflow onto its border.
The date retains DejaVu Sans Mono with a larger measured size and fixed line height, matching the reference white lettering proportion rather than shrinking it.
The clock face uses the four small cardinal marks visible in the reference, replacing the twelve oversized marks of the previous drawing.
asset_revisions.method: Independent integer-coordinate SVG geometry and QML layout, based on measured reference proportions; screenshot bitmaps are not embedded or distributed.

changes: The four instrument drawings use the 75/59 height ratio, keeping every button dimension, divider and relief unchanged.
The larger clock canvas is 134x134 canonical units; date/graph and Mail retain their native aspects in 152x90 and 142x70 boxes.

DejaVu Sans Mono is replaced by the bundled X11 Adobe Helvetica Bold 14 bitmap, scaled uniformly with the instruments. It is an explicitly documented alternative to the unavailable Swiss742 date bitmap, not an exact font reproduction.
asset_revisions.method: QML geometry plus application-local loading of a permissively licensed X11 bitmap font, with separate provenance and copyright in contents/fonts; no screenshot pixels or proprietary font files distributed.

changes: The existing empty lower-rail slot at x587 is now a graphic-only Applications drawer button, containing three independent overlapping rectangular program windows.
The two-color 32x24 integer SVG is an original drawing in the lower-rail symbol palette. Pinning and opening the drawer remain unimplemented.

The date keeps NativeRendering with platform-default font strategy, removing a forced NoAntialias setting. Qt 6.8 already samples native glyphs with Nearest; smooth:false is explicit and is not claimed as a fix of glyph filtering.
asset_revisions.method: Original integer SVG rectangles and QML visual feedback; no reference image or application action embedded.

changes: The user requests trying a Courier-style date; the applet now bundles Adobe Courier Bold14 Latin-1 instead of Helvetica.
The native14 strike, line17 and uniform 2*75/59 scale are retained; 65x35 displayed ink fits the unchanged 76x44.33 date face.
Small optical offsets center the Courier ink; all buttons, drawings and platform-default rasterization settings remain unchanged.
asset_revisions.method: Application-local Qt FontLoader for an unchanged permissively licensed X11 PCF, with separate license and provenance; no font installation or preferences modified.
